fact: The minutes of a meeting with district councils at Mangochi on 20 June 2024 record councils saying their ICT is managed centrally by the Government Wide Area Network and that some offices have bandwidth problems, and the project team answering that the network's footprint had grown from serving IFMIS to connectivity across the country; at Lilongwe City Council on 16 July 2024 the team said E-Government lacks the technical staff to support all 35 local councils promptly; the plan gives no count of councils connected.
title: Digital Malawi Acceleration Project (P505095): Stakeholder Engagement Plan
